name: PROSUS NV  EO -,05
summary: Prosus N.V. is a global consumer internet group and one of the largest technology investors in the world. Through its investments, it operates and invests globally in markets with long-term growth potential, building leading companies in the online classifieds, payments and fintech, food delivery, etail, education, and social and internet platforms sectors and is headquartered in Amsterdam, Netherlands.
